scenarios.prompt: Acquire one target from a revisioned candidate set using authored ranking and hysteresis, then let camera, facing, HUD and attack systems consume that target according to their own policies.

criteria.identity: Lock session, target ID, candidate revision and acquire/switch/drop reason are explicit.
criteria.determinism: Equal candidates use authored deterministic tie-break/hysteresis rather than iteration order.
criteria.ownership: HUD and camera presentation consume target identity but do not author it.
